answer: Clone farms cheaply mint identities to harvest emissions. Counter: each key splits 90 units of onyx collateral via 2-of-3 Shamir and lodges shares at three VRF-chosen keepers. The key stays inert until keepers post a joint anchor receipt. A later whisper audit names one shard at random and demands a reconstruction demo within 12 minutes; a miss burns that 30-unit shard and freezes intake for two epochs. Verifiers recompute VRF(epoch, pubkey) and match share-commitment plus demo hashes. Extra clones each pay another 90-unit lock plus 1.5 keeper fees, so flooding scales linearly.
